notes.title: Join the Pro Philosopher Release Party!
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2120070/Pro_Philosopher_2_Governments__Grievances/]Pro Philosopher 2 has a new demo as part of Steam Next Fest[/url], so we figured we'd take this opportunity to celebrate all things Pro Philosopher! And we couldn't do that without giving some love to the first game, where it all began!

So! This [b]Wednesday at 5:00 PM PST[/b], we will be [url=https://discord.com/invite/a9WvnXPZjB]hosting a hangout on our Discord[/url] where we will stream the original game, give behind the scenes insights, and answer questions. I'm really looking forward to it, so I hope to see you all there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42832916/272f8a9e1dbb2e6872bc241bc150c756f3aab26c.png[/img]

Throughout the rest of the week, we'll also be having various Steam Streams to celebrate the release of the new Demo. You can learn more about THAT on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2120070/announcements/detail/4185612701692868348]Pro Philosopher 2 Event Page[/url] here, but I suppose we could at least leave you with a teaser:

[previewyoutube=tFBrzfQsnmQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for all your support! [i]Socrates Jones: Pro Philosopher[/i] was a blast to make, and I can't wait to play it with you all Wednesday! Don't forget to sign up for our [url=https://discord.com/invite/a9WvnXPZjB]Discord Community[/url] to get all the updates on both games going forward!

notes.title: New Year's Minor Patch
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Hope you are having a lovely holiday season and have some fun New Year's plans.

We've been making steady progress on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2120070/Pro_Philosopher_2_Governments__Grievances/]Pro Philosopher 2[/url], but we took some time to circle back to the first game and fix some minor errors our [url=https://discord.gg/24DMEqKx]new discord community[/url] pointed out to us!

[list]
[*]The idea Kant adds to the Idea Slate in the final chapter is actually the one the game says it is
[*]Socrates doesn't add an "e" to "argument" when being shamed for being an accountant
[/list]
While I was in the script, I also made this goofy change to our already goofy bonus argument:
[list]
[*]Ari's game preferences have been updated to reflect the back half of 2023.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42832916/e6dff18e0b262dc1e88c5da531e859e5f02b4f94.png[/img] 

Who knows, maybe I'll wind up doing that bit every year.
